request.style: English, male baritone, gritty, solo, acoustic guitar, upright bass, brushed drums, mournful, slow blues, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The armies met at Ebenezer
Israel fell before the foe
Four thousand men were struck down
The elders cried out in woe
Bring the ark from Shiloh
Let it save us from the hand
Carry the covenant of the Lord
Who sits between the cherubim

[Chorus]
Ichabod, the glory is gone
The ark of God is taken
Ichabod, the light is faded
The strength of Israel is shaken

[Verse]
Hophni and Phinehas are dead
The slaughter was very great
Thirty thousand soldiers fell
Every man ran for his gate
A man of Benjamin ran in
Clothes torn and dirt on his head
He reached Shiloh to tell the news
The whole city cried instead

[Chorus]
Ichabod, the glory is gone
The ark of God is taken
Ichabod, the light is faded
The strength of Israel is shaken

[Bridge]
Eli sat by the road
His heart trembled for the ark
Ninety-eight years of leadership
He was old, his eyes were dim
When the news of the capture came
He fell backward from his seat
His neck was broken in the dust
He died where he sat

[Verse]
His daughter-in-law felt the pain
Pregnant near the time of birth
She heard of the loss of all
Her husband and her father-in-law
As she was dying in the night
The women said do not be afraid
You have given birth to a son
But she did not answer them

[Outro]
She named the boy Ichabod
The glory has departed from Israel
